QuestInfo.name: [Crimsonheart] Battle with Predators
QuestInfo.1: Go to the Hall of the Night 1/2 beyond the last door to defeat 200 Crimson Stirges and 200 Elite Nightshadows.
QuestInfo.2: You defeated all 200 Red Crimson Stirges and all 200 Elite Nightshadows.

0.0: Only three are left. It's time for the final fight. You ready? You'll need to take out 200 monsters this time.

yes.0: Don't give me that look. You'll be fine.\r\n(Take the final door into the Hall of the Night, then hunt 200 Crimson Stirges and Elite Nightshadows.)

no.0: You're bailing out on the final mission?!

1.0: Did you REALLY hunt down all those beasties?

yes.0: You did it! All those little kiddies can get out of there! (Talk to Pepper.)

default.0: Enter the Hall of the Night beyond the last door to defeat 200 Crimson Stirges and 200 Elite Nightshadows.
